[[Reykjavík]], Iceland | capacity = 1.650 | season = [[2025 Besta deild karla|2025]] | website = {{URL|http://www.fram.is/}} | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = | pattern_ra1 = | leftarm1 = 0000CC | body1 = 0000CC | rightarm1 = 0000CC | shorts1 = FFFFFF | socks1 = 0000CC | pattern_la2 = | pattern_b2 = | pattern_ra2 = | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks2 = FFFFFF| }} '''''Knattspyrnufélagið Fram''''' ({{IPA|is|ˈkʰnahtˌspɪ(r)tnʏˌfjɛːˌlaijɪð ˈfram}}, {{lit|Fram Football Club}}{{efn|''Knattspyrnufélagið'' is the [[Definiteness|definite form]] of ''Knattspyrnufélag'', meaning "the football club".}}) is a professional Icelandic [[Sports club|multi-sport club]], best known for its [[association football|football]] and [[handball]] teams. It was founded on 1 May 1908 in [[Reykjavík]]. It was based at Safamýri, in the [[Háaleiti og Bústaðir]] district near [[Reykjavík]] city centre until 2006 when Fram started slowly moving operations to Úlfarsárdalur in the newly established [[Grafarholt]] district. Fram has been based fully in Úlfarsárdalur since mid 2022.{{Cite web |title=Íþróttamiðstöð Fram verður tilbúin 2022 |url=https://www.mbl.is/frettir/innlent/2019/10/25/ithrottamidstod_fram_verdur_tilbuin_2022/ |access-date=2025-12-05 |website=www.mbl.is |language=is}} The men's football team currently plays in the top division, the [[Besta deild karla]] after being promoted in the [[1. deild karla (football)|2021 season]]. The women's football team also currently plays in the top division, the [[Besta deild kvenna]] after being promoted in the 2024 season The club also has strong handball teams; the men's team won the [[Úrvalsdeild karla (handball)|Icelandic championship]] and Icelandic cup in 2025. Both teams play in the top division of icelandic handball. Other sports offered by the club include [[taekwondo]] and [[skiing]]."}}
